name: Anthropic Model Hardware Standard Research Preview — Hardware-Splicer

fields.proposed_contribution: Independent safety-evaluation/control harness for testing evidence sufficiency, authority escalation and failure recovery around an MHS-enabled programmable physical device.

packet_requirements.description: Prepared MHS capability/contribution note with integration, adversarial safety evaluation, recovery analysis and reusable-output work packages.
Name a real programmable physical device/model, its interface, bounded actions and location/access plan.
Inspect the live interest form and verify whether an individual university researcher is accepted; if not, identify a YZU faculty/lab route.

compliance_checks: Do not claim Hardware-Splicer implements MHS before preview integration exists.
Do not represent the applicant as a manufacturing lab or institutional stakeholder unless that is actually true.
Do not fire a software-only interest pitch without a concrete programmable hardware surface.
Keep pending live-model and physical evidence pending.
